why: During the full run on this commit the laptop entered Modern Standby repeatedly (10:09–10:25, then brief entries at 10:30, 10:31 and 10:43 local time). The four browser suites running in those windows were throttled: two outlived their 25-minute timers and two timed out loading their first page. None of them exercises Sol’s checks. Each is re-run here alone on the same commit.
